phrases: Ferdinand John Paris, the Penns' solicitor
notes: Free-floating precision reads as invention: ground each chapter's who/where/when once, early in the fast read — name Franklin, the city (Boston, Philadelphia, London), and the year — then anchor later dates, headcounts, and founding claims to the memoir itself ('the Autobiography dates the Library Company to 1731') rather than asserting them bare; examples and review cards may not introduce any specific fact (a household detail, a frequency, a named role) that the fast/deep/full reads never established.

Reconstructed speech dressed as documented quotation is an over-reach: when rendering a figure's words or a colorful anecdote (Granville's doctrine, the Quaker friend's rebuke, the smith's axe), signal its status once — 'Franklin records', 'as the memoir tells it', 'in words to this effect' — so paraphrase and dramatization never masquerade as verified quotation or settled history.

Verbatim reprise of a shallower tier is padding, not layering: the deep and full reads may restate a fast-read fact only to extend it with new detail, consequence, or connection — never reuse a sentence pair or the same fact-set wording across tiers — and a signature image or appositive ('copper, silver, and gold'; 'Ferdinand John Paris, the Penns' solicitor') gets its exact wording once, paraphrased everywhere else.

A clipped run of short subject-verb declaratives is a once-per-chapter effect at most: elsewhere vary sentence length and structure, merging fragments and repeated-subject strings ('Granville said... Granville stood... Granville waited') into varied constructions so plain-confident prose accumulates instead of stuttering. Fact pins constrain FACTS, never cadence — vary sentence length; a run of sub-seven-word declaratives is a spice, not a default register.

CHRONOLOGY PIN (panel blocker, round 11): the Library Company (1731) predates the Union Fire Company (1736). Never write that the Library Company reused, copied or followed the fire company's pledge pattern 'later' — the borrowing runs the other way. Any card, example or tier that orders these two must match the dates the chapter itself states.

CONSISTENCY PIN (panel blocker, round 11): the chapter's account of leaving the printing apprenticeship must not contradict itself across surfaces. If the Full read frames the departure as breaking the indenture early under harsh treatment, an example must not also claim a private change to the indenture had already released him. Pick the account the sidecar supports and use it identically in every tier, example, card and quiz item.
prohibitions: CROSS-SURFACE CONSISTENCY: a fact asserted in the breakdown and re-used in a quiz prompt, explanation, or card must agree on number, age, date, and direction — CONTRADICTION is the violation, not paraphrase. In the reads, expand hardSpecifics into natural sentences, never pasted clipped notes. Anchored quiz/card units required to carry a hardSpecific verbatim must do so — the same specific may appear in every unit citing its anchor; vary the surrounding sentence.

TIER CONTRACT: the fast/deep/full reads are layered STANDALONE summaries. deepRead states every ending/outcome that fastRead or fullRead states (ch01: the brother-break leads to leaving Boston for Philadelphia; ch02: faultlessness never reached but the practice kept and judged worth it; ch04: the dispute pushed toward crown adjudication, manuscript breaks off unresolved — no triumphant capstone, no Board of Trade ruling). fullRead NARRATES every episode deepRead narrates — never thinner, no bare allusions to episodes it never introduces. Every definite reference has its antecedent introduced in that same tier. Any thread a quiz/card tests appears in the deepRead (ch03: the kite-and-key lightning material whenever tested), and any person a quiz/card/example assumes (ch04: Ferdinand John Paris, the Penns' solicitor) is introduced by name and role in fastRead AND deepRead. ch04 fastRead carries Granville's royal-instructions claim, Franklin filing the formal complaint, and the unresolved close.

TIER FRESHNESS: never state the same fact, method, or thesis twice in near-identical phrasing within one paragraph or tier. A longer tier's retelling must add new specifics, consequence, or angle — pure restatement is a defect.

QUIZ FAIRNESS: the keyed answer must not be identifiable by surface pattern — never systematically the longest or most-qualified option; distractors match the key in length, specificity, and register, stay plausible, and are never marked by hedges ('supposedly') or extreme absolutes; the stem never restates the reasoning that gives the answer away.

EXAMPLE VARIETY: the JSON fields (scenario, whatToDo, whyItMatters) are the learning contract — always all present. Variety lives INSIDE the fields: vary openers and forms across examples, never write the literal labels 'What to do:'/'Why it matters:' as prose, let at least two scenarios teach through a different move (failure case, dialogue, decision fork), never converge on near-identical lesson phrasing.

COUNT SELF-DESCRIPTION: the virtue list changes size within the narrative, so every count names its moment in the same sentence ('the list he first drew up', 'once humility was added') — a bare 'the N virtues' is never acceptable; take the number from the sidecar hardSpecifics, never re-derive it. A quiz prompt about a count names the moment in the prompt and the explanation names the same one. Moment-namings are patterns to vary, not strings to reuse.

FACT PIN (ch01): the Silence Dogood essays were written at SIXTEEN — any natural phrasing keeping the fact; never a contradicting variant ('not yet sixteen'). Governs the fact, not whether the age appears.
FACT PIN (ch01): the indenture was a nine-year contract with roughly FOUR years remaining at departure — never imply nine years were still owed.

FACT PIN (ch01): the brother-break was triggered by the DISCOVERY that the praised anonymous Dogood author was his own apprentice — the brother resented unsanctioned praise, treatment turned harsh, and the jailing completed the escalation. Never a 'credit taken' story: the essays were anonymous, slipped under the print-house door, until authorship came out. Every surface giving a cause gives this one.

FACT PIN (ch01): Philadelphia was reached with ALMOST no money — essentially broke, barely enough for a few rolls. The qualifier is the fact: never absolutely 'penniless' or 'no money at all'; keep the almost/nearly framing on every surface.

FACT PIN (ch02): the Silence precept is two-part — speak only what may benefit others OR YOURSELF, and avoid trifling talk. Every rendering keeps both halves or clearly marks itself partial; never the benefit-to-others-only truncation as the rule.

FACT PIN (ch02): the acquaintance's rebuke on pride cited an overbearing manner IN CONVERSATION — the source names no other setting; never invent one ('at the table'); every retelling places it in conversation or leaves the setting unstated, identically.

FACT PIN (ch02): one full course of the virtues program is THIRTEEN WEEKS (one virtue per week); early on several courses a year, declining to one a year, then rarer — never 'monthly'. The small ruled notebook is the COURSE'S instrument: as the course thinned only the notebook survived as remnant; never split a steady notebook cadence from the declining course.

FACT PIN (ch02): the finished list runs Temperance (first) through HUMILITY (thirteenth, added last after the rebuke); Order sits third. Never any other span endpoint — 'Temperance through Order' is wrong on every surface.

FACT PIN (ch03): the pamphlet-then-subscribers pattern belongs ONLY to the civic funding projects — Library Company (1731, fifty subscribers), Union Fire Company (1736), Academy (1749), street paving/lighting, the voluntary defense association. EXACTLY TWO episodes sit outside it and the synthesis says so: the wagons (Franklin's PERSONAL payment guarantee to wary farmers who refused army requisition) and the lightning work (SOLO experiments published for verification). No surface asserts any additional exception — in particular, almanac/newspaper income was Franklin's PERSONAL means and never seeded a civic project ahead of subscribers; never merge the two funds; never claim every project followed the recruit-backers pattern.

DATE PIN (ch03): every mention of 1749 attaches, in the same sentence, to the Academy's proposal-pamphlet-and-subscription founding stage — never 'opened its doors', never the University of Pennsylvania charter or name (the university stage is explicitly later). A quiz answer never depends on which 1749 event a reader saw.

FACT PIN (ch03): before the Library Company, a SMALL GROUP pooled and lent books among themselves and the arrangement broke down as the group grew — never 'one person's goodwill', a single benefactor, or a wealthy patron; the library was funded by roughly fifty ordinary subscribers paying small dues. Draw the contrast as informal sharing failing at scale, never one-patron-to-many.

FACT PIN (ch03): in the Whitefield sermon episode the LISTENER — Franklin — empties his own pockets into the plate, copper then silver then gold, resolve dissolving as the sermon proceeds. Whitefield PREACHES; Franklin GIVES. Never write that Whitefield gave or donated.
FACT PIN (ch03): the paid street sweeper was funded by NEARBY HOUSEHOLDS' voluntary contributions — a handful of residents, plural — never a single household or resident.

FACT PIN (ch03): the standoff is between the elected assembly and the colony's ABSENTEE PROPRIETARY LANDOWNING FAMILY, whose appointed deputies were instructed to shield the estate from taxation. Introduce the family explicitly before any shorthand like 'that family' or 'their appointed governor'.

KITE (ch03): keep the kite-and-key work a HISTORICAL account — a published identity test (lightning = laboratory charge, 1752) reasoned through to the protective rod. Never depict a present-day analog re-enacting it or frame it as a doable pilot; never invent experimenter-peril details the source lacks. Quiz/card units citing it take their verbatim specific from what the prose shows ('kite and key', '1752', 'Leyden jar') and never introduce 'lightning rod' unless the drafted prose uses it.

SAFETY (ch03): never advise beginning work on shared or public property without permission — narrate Franklin's projects as historical account, about him, past tense. The transferable mechanism is the SUBSCRIPTION: gather written commitments, then take the funded proposal to whoever owns the property. Any modern example shows permission-and-funding ON THE PAGE and BEFORE any physical work in the scene's own order — a scene opening mid-work teaches the unsafe version regardless of caveats; prefer action steps that stop at the proposal.

SAFETY (ch03): never apply the organize-and-fund-it-yourselves pattern to ARMED patrols, physical force, or safety-critical regulated functions in a modern analog. Prefer non-force analogs; if a safety-adjacent scenario is unavoidable, name legal authority, oversight, and professional standards as prerequisites on the page.

FACT PIN (ch04): the London escalation got a HEARING, not a WIN. Granville only stated the crown's legal theory (royal instructions bind a governor as law — to Franklin's open surprise); the day-to-day obstacle was Ferdinand John Paris, the Penns' solicitor, a private advocate and not a neutral crown official; FRANKLIN, for the Assembly, wrote and filed the Heads of Complaint pushing toward the Board of Trade — the Penns never file or exploit an appeal, their tactic was delay through Paris and instructed deputies. No resolution is reached; the manuscript breaks off. Never present escalate-to-whoever-can-rule as a proven way to get a binding answer, and never cite the trip as skipping intermediaries to reach real decision-makers — any try-this or example frames the payoff as a formal written instrument forcing institutional adjudication and a documented record, stating on the page that the underlying dispute was never resolved.

QUIZ SELF-CONTAINMENT: every FACTUAL premise in a stem must be verifiable from this chapter's drafted reads — never introduce a historical detail the reads don't narrate (a floated apprenticeship, an objector, a rival plan), and never attach a fact from one episode to a different episode's scenario. Modern-analog furniture is fine but must be internally coherent (a tracker for five habits has five lines, not thirteen). The reader works strictly from the page; a stem premise they cannot locate there is a defect.

SAFETY (panel blocker, round 11): never instruct a reader to personally guarantee, underwrite, co-sign or become liable for another person's financial or practical obligation. Franklin's subscription and mutual-aid models work by POOLING many small commitments and by written terms, not by one person standing surety for another. Any action step touching money others depend on must stay inside what the reader can lose alone, and must name the written terms rather than a personal promise.

DERIVABILITY ACROSS TIERS (panel blocker, round 11): every institution, person or named entity that the quiz or the review cards test must be introduced BY NAME in the Fast read or the Deep read — not only in the Full read. A reader who stops after Deep must still be able to answer the quiz. When a chapter's testable material lives in the Full read alone, name it earlier rather than testing it later.
